verdict.rationale: Capacities ships its own REST API, with an OpenAPI spec and a TypeScript SDK, that reads and writes objects, properties, block content and daily notes, plus an MCP integration. That is real programmatic coverage of core content. Nothing documents parity with the UI, though, and the Beta API is being replaced by a new generation, so the extent of coverage is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity claim or endpoint coverage map, evidence of API access to UI features like templates, object-type creation, graph, search, export scheduling and sharing, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Capacities API is a REST API that allows you access, create and manipulate your content.
The Capacities REST API gives you programmatic access to a workspace space — read and write objects, properties, block content, daily notes, and more.
Interactive **reference** for all routes of the Capacities API.
